This Writ Petition has been filed to direct the 1 st respondent to pay interest on the alleged delay in payment of the compensation to the petitioner in respect of the lands acquired from the petitioner based on his representation dated 08.12.2025 within a time frame fixed by this Court.

2.Earlier, the petitioner had challenged the deduction of 1/3rd from the compensation amount determined by the respondents on account of development charges before this Court by filing a Writ Petition in W.P.No.35735 of 2024.
By the order dated 25.11.2024, the said Writ Petition came to be allowed and the deduction of 1/3rd towards development charges was quashed by this Court.

However, according to the petitioner, there was a delay on the part of the respondents to pay the entire compensation amount.

The petitioner seeks for payment of interest for the delayed payment at the rate of 9% per annum for the first year till 19.06.2025 and thereafter, at the rate of 15% per annum till 14.08.2025 as per the provisions of Section 72 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the RFCTLARR Act for the sake of convenience).

sentences.text: The petitioner had given a representation for the aforesaid purposes on 08.12.2025 to the respondents.
Since the same has not been considered, the petitioner has filed the present Writ Petition.
No prejudice would be caused to the respondents if the petitioners representation dated 08.12.2025 is considered in accordance with law within the time frame to be fixed by this Court.
3.Mr.P.Sathish, learned Additional Government Pleader takes notice on behalf of the respondents.

However, there shall be no order as to costs.
